lines.en: I cross the plains toward the village

lines.zh: 我手里拿着刚换来的水晶
lines.en: I carry the crystal I just traded for
My eyes are pale violet

lines.zh: 我沿着自己的房子走一圈
lines.en: I make a loop around my own house
I only go out to work at night

lines.zh: 我踩过的草叶慢慢立回来
lines.en: The grass I tread slowly rights itself

lines.zh: 我抱着几块石头走回家
lines.en: I carry a few stones home
I step over the threshold

lines.zh: 我的手指摩挲着恩杜密
lines.en: My fingers rub the Endumium
I go around the neighbor's wall

lines.zh: 我把水晶揣在怀里赶路
lines.en: I hurry along with the crystal at my chest
I go around the edge of the square
I sit at my own doorstep
I lay the crystals out one by one
I count what I traded for today
My six-coloured eyes shine at night
I look at each one in turn
I crack my knuckles
I wait for dawn, or something else

lines.zh: 我一动不动地守着屋子
lines.en: I guard the house without moving

lines.zh: 我的屋顶是我自己搭的
lines.en: I built this roof myself

lines.zh: 门外有脚步，我竖起耳朵
lines.en: Footsteps outside the door and my ears prick up.
I rest my hands on the windowsill

lines.zh: 我把桌上的东西理了理
lines.en: I tidy what is on the table
Have you come to trade
I have Endumium here

lines.zh: 你手上的东西我看不清
lines.en: I cannot see clearly what you carry
We only do business at night
One step back and we talk outside my threshold.

lines.zh: 我的房子是我一块块垒的
lines.en: I built this house stone by stone
You do not look like anyone from around here
I look up and size your height
We rarely invite anyone in

lines.zh: 你要换，就把东西放地上
lines.en: To trade, put your goods on the ground
I know the smell on your hands
First tell me what you want
Our trade follows rules

lines.zh: 你身上带着外面的味道
lines.en: You carry the smell of outside
I took a blow

lines.zh: 我抱着的晶体撒了一地
lines.en: The crystals I held spilled across the ground

lines.zh: 我撞在门框上，喘了口气
lines.en: I hit the doorframe and catch my breath.
My people will know
That taught me caution
Blood runs between my fingers
I whistled for help
I retreat into the house
I am not so old that I cannot stand
I will deal with this wound myself
Is that an apple in your hand
I do like apples
That one in your hand is very red

lines.zh: 苹果的味道勾了我一下
lines.en: The smell of apples pulls me a step closer.

lines.zh: 这个我可以给你换水晶
lines.en: I could trade you crystal for this
We eat these at home
Do not hold it too high

lines.zh: 我够得到，但我不喜欢仰头
lines.en: I can reach it, but I dislike looking up

lines.zh: 你把它递过来，我们就谈
lines.en: Hand it over and we will talk
I smell it, very sweet
You hit my shoulder

lines.zh: 我手里的水晶差点掉了
lines.en: I nearly dropped my crystal

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我退了半步
lines.en: We bumped, I gave half a step
You are bigger than I am
I hold the crystal tighter
I turn my shoulder to let you by
That bump annoyed me somewhat

lines.zh: 我的手指在你袖子上停了一下
lines.en: My fingers paused on your sleeve

lines.zh: 我们之间保持这个距离就好
lines.en: This distance between us is fine
Don't nudge me with your elbow, guest.

lines.zh: 这种事在我们村里很平常
lines.en: Such things are ordinary in our village
But you asked the wrong one
I have my own house to keep

lines.zh: 我的族人很多，选择也多
lines.en: My people are many, and so are the choices
Crystal cannot buy this
I looked away
I do not wish to discuss this
We have other business
I go back to arranging my crystals
There is much work at night
I stoop, pick it up, and weigh it in my palm.
This could trade for a few crystals
I hold it up against the light
That is a handsome color

lines.zh: 我把它收进腰间的布袋
lines.en: I slip it into the cloth pouch at my waist.
I pick up anything worth trading
This looks a little old
I worked out the price
This item is mine now
I set it out on my stall
Something is outside the village
I must call the guards
My hand is raised
This direction is wrong
First I count how many there are
I give a whistle
The ones nearby will hear
I retreat inside the door
I have dropped the door bar
I keep my hand on the bar without moving
My people have already come out
This direction is the gap in the fence
I watch outside from the window
It has not moved a step
The guards should be here soon
I moved the lamp away
My eyes see farther than the lamp
The guard at the door is moving
I am counting how many there are
I put the crystals in the chest
Our village can hold
Let it move first
I watch through the gap in the curtain

lines.zh: 它的脚步声在外面转了半圈
lines.en: Its steps have circled half the outside

lines.zh: 我的手一直没离开门闩
lines.en: My hand has not left the bar
I grab the tool at hand
I strike at its leg
I jab its chest with the handle of my hoe.
I fall back to the doorframe
I shoulder it away
My people will close in
I strike once and shout
I hold the doorway
I cannot hold alone for long
I use the doorframe as cover
I strike its arm once
I bat it back with the back of my hand

lines.zh: 我从自己的屋子里出来
lines.en: I come out of my own house
Every eave here I raised with my own hands.

lines.zh: 我在边境之地住过很久
lines.en: I lived long in the Borderlands
Now I build houses here

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在夜里看得很清
lines.en: My eyes see clearly at night
I do not go out armed

lines.zh: 和平的时候我们做生意
lines.en: In peacetime we trade
I close the door before I leave
My people are nearby
The plains here are quiet

lines.zh: 我已经在这个村子里住了几代
lines.en: My family has lived in this village for generations
My door faces east
I set down what I was working on
Fire caught my hem
I slipped off the roof

lines.zh: 水呛进喉咙，我抓不住岸
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I can't grip the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我连人带门一起掀开
lines.en: The blast threw me and the door apart
An arrow lodged in my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股术力在我手心里烧
lines.en: That magic burned in my palm
I was busy trading and forgot to eat

lines.zh: 雷打在我的屋顶上，瓦片掉了
lines.en: Lightning struck my roof and tiles fell

lines.zh: 我的房子和地都不见了
lines.en: My house and the ground are gone
